---
title: "GO Enrichment of TF Target Gene Sets (Table E)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

project_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Downloads", "AC_combined_analysis", "Adriana_analysis")
tables_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "output_tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)

select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r load-mitch-results}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Load mitch TF enrichment results from script 05.
# Use Table E (direct targets: bound + regulated) as it is
# the most stringent and biologically interpretable.
# Activated and repressed run separately (script 05 design)
# so load both and combine with a direction label.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_e_activated <- read_tsv(
  file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE_activated.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>% mutate(direction = "activated")

df_e_repressed <- read_tsv(
  file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE_repressed.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>% mutate(direction = "repressed")

df_e_all <- bind_rows(df_e_activated, df_e_repressed)

cat("Table E activated sets:", nrow(df_e_activated), "\n")
cat("Table E repressed sets:", nrow(df_e_repressed), "\n")
```

```{r select-top-tfs}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Select top 10 TFs to run GO enrichment on:
# top 5 by positive s.PC1 (active TOR/PKA signalling axis)
# top 5 by positive s.PC2 (large cell axis)
# Union of both, deduplicated.
# Using positive ends of each axis as these showed the
# strongest and most interpretable signals in script 05.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
top_pc1 <- df_e_all %>%
  arrange(desc(s.PC1)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(TF)

top_pc2 <- df_e_all %>%
  arrange(desc(s.PC2)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(TF)

selected_tfs <- union(top_pc1, top_pc2)
cat("Selected TFs for GO enrichment:\n")
print(selected_tfs)
```

```{r load-table-e}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Load Table E to extract target gene lists per TF.
# Table E = direct targets (TF both binds and regulates gene).
# Sign convention: log2FC < 0 = activated, log2FC > 0 = repressed
# on TF depletion.
# Filter to common genes used in script 05.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)
table_a   <- read_excel(file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_e   <- read_excel(file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "Table-S3e")

common_genes <- intersect(pca_genes$gene_id, table_a$gene_id)
table_e <- table_e %>% filter(gene_id %in% common_genes)

# Build target gene lists per TF (activated + repressed combined)
# for selected TFs only - all regulated targets regardless of direction
table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC), TF %in% selected_tfs)

tf_target_lists <- table_e_long %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

cat("Target gene counts per TF:\n")
print(map_int(tf_target_lists, length))
```

```{r run-go-enrichment}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Run enrichGO for each selected TF's target gene list.
# Background universe = all common PCA genes (consistent
# with scripts 01 and 05).
# Collect top 5 terms per TF for plotting.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
universe <- common_genes

run_go_per_tf <- function(tf_name, gene_list, universe) {
  tryCatch({
    ego <- enrichGO(
      gene          = gene_list,
      universe      = universe,
      OrgDb         = org.Sc.sgd.db,
      keyType       = "ORF",
      ont           = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
    )
    df <- as.data.frame(ego)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      mutate(TF = tf_name)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error for TF", tf_name, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })
}

cat("Running GO enrichment for", length(tf_target_lists), "TFs...\n")

go_results <- imap(tf_target_lists, ~run_go_per_tf(.y, .x, universe)) %>%
  compact() %>%
  bind_rows()

cat("GO enrichment complete.\n")
cat("TFs with significant GO terms:",
    length(unique(go_results$TF)), "of", length(selected_tfs), "\n")
```

```{r plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Faceted dot plot: one facet per TF, top 5 GO terms (BP)
# ordered by adjusted p-value within each facet.
# Dot size = gene count, colour = significance.
# TF order reflects PC1/PC2 axis membership.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Order TFs: PC1 axis first, then PC2 axis
tf_order <- c(
  intersect(top_pc1, unique(go_results$TF)),
  setdiff(intersect(top_pc2, unique(go_results$TF)),
          top_pc1)
)

go_plot_df <- go_results %>%
  mutate(
    Description_short = if_else(
      nchar(Description) > 45,
      str_trunc(Description, 45, ellipsis = "..."),
      Description
    ),
    TF = factor(TF, levels = tf_order),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(p.adjust)
  ) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  mutate(Description_short = fct_reorder(
    Description_short, neg_log10_padj)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(go_plot_df,
            aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = Description_short,
                size = Count, color = neg_log10_padj)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~TF, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#74c476", high = "#d6604d") +
  labs(
    title = "GO enrichment (BP) of direct TF target genes (Table E)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top 5 significant GO terms per TF | ",
      "TFs selected from mitch Table E enrichment (script 05) | ",
      "Background: ", length(universe), " PCA genes"
    ),
    x     = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    y     = NULL,
    size  = "Gene count",
    color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey40")
  )

print(p)
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(go_results,
          file.path(output_dir, "go_tf_targets_tableE.txt"))

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_go_tf_targets.png"),
       plot = p, width = 14, height = 10)

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
